title: The Enormous Turnip
description: NCERT Class 3 English (Marigold): 'The Enormous Turnip'. New words, comprehension, opposites, and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'The Enormous Turnip': turnip, enormous, pull, together.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'The Enormous Turnip' mean (turnip, enormous, pull, together); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: To bring something towards you, you ___ it.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: The enormous turnip was hard to pull.
Together, the family pulled it out.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'The Enormous Turnip' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'The Enormous Turnip'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: They could only move the turnip when they all worked ___.
The huge turnip came out only when everyone pulled ___.

exemplars: The enormous turnip was hard to pull.
Together, the family pulled it out.

nodes.title: Opposites
nodes.teach_focus: Opposite words have opposite meanings: big/small, pull/push, up/down.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses opposites correctly in a sentence.

bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: Big is the opposite of small.
We push the door, then pull it.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'The Enormous Turnip'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'The Enormous Turnip': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: When we work together, a hard job becomes ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.
A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: The enormous turnip was hard to pull.
Together, the family pulled it out.

items.prompt: To bring something towards you, you ___ it.
They could only move the turnip when they all worked ___.
The huge turnip came out only when everyone pulled ___.
